exposure: Enhanced community doula intervention (Best Beginnings for Babies - BBB)
cohort: Participants in a randomized controlled trial comparing an enhanced community doula intervention to routine maternity care for individuals receiving care at Boston Medical Center, specifically aiming to serve low-income populations.
finding: The enhanced community doula program (BBB) resulted in average healthcare savings of $1,152 per patient compared to routine care, yielding an 18% return on investment, largely due to lower birth hospitalization and NICU stay costs.
